deviations: isBlackoutDate(key) is implemented as blackoutsForKey(key).length>0 (1-arg = ALL by-date entries) rather than the contract's literal blackoutsForKey(key,'') which would only match store-wide entries. Reason: the binding intent is 'store-agnostic' (a Helios-only blackout is still a blackout day to flag on the strip/marker); the literal '' form would silently miss store-specific blackouts. blackoutsForKey uses arguments.length>=2 to distinguish 'marker/omitted => all' from 'gate/provided (incl "") => store-wide OR that store', which preserves the required 'unassigned employee never gets false store-specific warnings' behavior. Verified both paths in the sandbox.

P1-28 caps panel HTML and P1-29 blackout panel HTML were inserted together in one Edit (adjacent static markup after the Weekly-Off panel) rather than in two separate passes; order is caps-then-blackout with distinct ids, exactly matching the collision resolution.
